name: lumen-editor
description: A cross-platform text editor built with Electron, TypeScript and CodeMirror 6

scripts.dev:mac: npm run fix:mac && npm run dev
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.test:shared: tsc --outDir out-test --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --types node src/shared/ipc.ts src/shared/text.ts src/shared/filePolicy.ts src/shared/losslessJson.ts src/shared/git.ts src/shared/lspProtocol.ts src/renderer/src/documents.ts src/renderer/src/fuzzy.ts src/renderer/src/symbols.ts src/renderer/src/incrementalDiff.ts src/renderer/src/lineTransforms.ts src/renderer/src/navigationHistory.ts src/renderer/src/selectionCommands.ts && node src/shared/text.test.mjs && node src/shared/core.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:shared && npm run typecheck && npm run build
